name: use-theme
title: useTheme
description: The theme engine: light, dark, system, and OLED, with persistence and theme-color meta kept in sync.
docs: Use this instead of hand-rolling matchMedia listeners, dark-class toggling, or theme-color meta updates. Two modes: uncontrolled (pass storageKey and the hook owns localStorage) or controlled (pass mode from your own settings store). The theme colour derives from the background tokens, so a token change reaches the meta tag with no per-app edit.
